Please deliver each as a self-contained float file under `figures/` / `tables/` (`.tex` with the `\begin{figure}`/`\begin{table}`, caption and label; PDF beside it), width ≤ 5.5 in, the caption naming cells, σ, s, n, d, p, design and tier.
  > 
  > | label | what | text section |
  > |---|---|---|
  > | `tab:mech` | T1: mechanisms (a)–(g), form, τ, direct part, DM bias at s=.5, SNR; main text, short | design |
  > | `fig:regime` | F1: regime map (log RMSE ratio to DM over s × mechanism at d=20, p=½), s* panel with the d=5 bound marked, real-graph rows | results §3.2 |
  > | `fig:bias` | F3: bias and SD vs d per mechanism class (upper row), bias/SD vs p (lower row); caption must carry the mechanism qualifier on d-independence | results §3.1 |
  > | `fig:tiers` | F5: tiers at the core cells, Tier A scoped to 200 draws per graph | results §3.2 |
  > | `fig:cluster` | F6: γ = 1, 3 and planted partition; γ=0.3 stated as degenerate | results §3.3 |
  > | `fig:diag` | F7: held-out log-RMSE, combined vs best benchmark, constant line, per-group gains, D* part (i) separate | results §3.4 |
  > | `tab:accept` | T2: acceptance criteria with value, CI, verdict and absolute held-out R² column + constant row | results §3.4 |
  > | `fig:cov` | F9: coverage vs |bias|/SD and vs L; nominal marked | results §3.6 |
  > | `fig:var` (appendix `app:var`) | F2: realised variance vs σ²L/n with the n, d, p exponents | appendix |
  > | `fig:robust` | F8: edge noise q=0, 0.1, 0.3 (bias and S) | results §3.5 |
  > | `tab:regime` | T3: regime table with coverage and sign-error rate | appendix |
  > 
  > Main text budget: 9 pages including all of these (6 figures, 2 tables); if a figure cannot be legible at about 2.7 in per panel, tell me and I will move it to the appendix rather than shrink it.
